description: The only test touching Gleam_rules is a printf smoke test (src/ocaml/test/ast/catseye_ast_test.ml:54). 41 registered rules have zero behavioral assertions. Before any refactor of gleam_rules.ml we need golden tests: parse tests/fixtures/gleam/**/*.gleam samples via the existing gleam parser, run Gleam_rules.analyze_module, and assert exact (rule_id, line) findings per fixture. Cover at least: let-assert (test vs non-test file), panic/todo, single-branch case, unused let, hardcoded secrets, pipeline-steps-overload. Prerequisite for the traversal/fold and module-split refactor tickets.
title: Golden-fixture tests for Gleam AI-linter rules
